name: replace_selected_object_motion_resource

stack.evidence: func_001D1238 consumes two indices, resolves a motion-resource descriptor through D_003D55D4, passes it to func_001313A8 for the selected object, and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: func_001313A8 preserves the selected object's original 16-byte motion-resource descriptor at +0x1D0 in the backup at +0x1E0 before installing the replacement through func_001320B8. The handler records Script flag 0x80 so command 95 restore_selected_object_motion_resource can restore that backup exactly once. The JP corpus contains 291 calls; each supplies a motion-set selector and a resource index before a replacement animation sequence.
